scripts.kill: pkill -f 'uvicorn' && echo '✅ Backend server stopped' || echo '✅ Backend not running'
scripts.kill:port: lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Port 8000 freed' || echo '✅ Port 8000 already free'
scripts.kill:jupyter: pkill -f 'jupyter' && echo '✅ Jupyter stopped' || echo '✅ Jupyter not running'
scripts.status: ps aux | grep 'uvicorn' | grep -v grep || echo 'Backend not running'
